articles.title: Maruti Suzuki Ertiga gets costlier by up to ₹10,000: 16,911 units sold last month; check new variant-wise prices
articles.description: Maruti Suzuki has raised prices on select Ertiga variants by up to ₹10,000. The ZXi Plus petrol manual and automatic versions saw the biggest increases, while Tour M petrol and CNG variants rose by ₹2,500.
